summary: 1–8, John Murdock is called to proclaim the gospel, and those who receive him receive the Lord and will obtain mercy.
meta_description: Revelation given through Joseph Smith the Prophet to John Murdock, August 29, 1832, at Hiram, Ohio. For over a year, John Murdock had been preaching the gospel while his children—motherless after the death of his wife, Julia Clapp, in April 1831—resided with other families in Ohio.
